reasons: Admitted on the vendor's own fetched documentation; this application has not run a live key gate against this endpoint.
China-region platform: keys are issued by and bound to the China account system and are not interchangeable with the international platform's keys.
The vendor's OpenAI-dialect reasoning replay contract must not be assumed for Anthropic Messages without a dialect-specific document or probe.
Per the glm-5.3 model page, accounts that have ever subscribed to the GLM Coding Plan are temporarily limited to OpenAI Chat for metered calls, so this root may refuse such accounts.
